Aisha (CSM): Heads up — MaplePay post-POC activity dropped ~78% last week and their ML team kicked off a 'PiggyBack AI' pilot with a competitor yesterday. Need quick renewal-risk triage. :eyes:
redwood-bot: [alert] account_usage_drop: MaplePay (acct_2245) — 78% decline week-over-week. Alert ID: UDF-2245-03
Jon (AE): ugh — when did the champion (Priya) go quiet? any procurement signals?
Miguel (SE): They stopped calling the inference endpoint heavily starting 2025-11-12. Small telemetry snippet below for tokens/day:```
2025-11-07: 48,200
2025-11-08: 51,750
2025-11-09: 10,900
2025-11-10: 9,200
2025-11-11: 6,800
2025-11-12: 3,400
```
Aisha (CSM): Champion (Priya) still on the account but hasn't replied to last two emails. Procurement mentioned pilot with 'PiggyBack AI' in a short call last week. No formal RFP yet.
Ellen (CS Ops): Suggested playbook: 1) immediate 30m call to re-surface value; 2) surface quant metrics & regression checks tied to their eval set; 3) offer short Dedicated pilot credit or usage forgiveness for model-compat testing. I'll take scheduling.
Jon (AE): I'll bring commercial note — ask for start date & scope of competitor pilot. If they're testing model-parity we need a quick side-by-side ask. Can someone pull last 90-day prompt-set eval?
Miguel (SE): Pulled a diff of top 5 prompt success rates vs baseline (summary): "Baseline v1 -> 92%", "MaplePay current -> 78% (drop on retrieval-heavy prompts)". Sending eval pkg to Jon and Aisha now: https://console.redwood.ai/internal/evals/maplepay-2245
Aisha (CSM): Nice — Jon, can you commit to a 48h outreach cadence? Ellen, once call is booked, add Miguel's eval to agenda.
Ellen (CS Ops): Booked 30m with Priya for 2025-11-14 10:00 PT. Added agenda: usage trend, competitor scope, quick demo of prefix/KV caching improvements and Dedicated pilot terms. Invite includes link to telemetry + eval pkg.
Jon (AE): On the call I'll ask for permission to share a constrained A/B with their ML lead (1-week side-by-side), and propose a small dedicated credit to remove infra mismatch as reason to switch. :thumbsup:
Miguel (SE): Prep notes: quick config we can flip during A/B: enable prefix caching, reduce batch size for latency-sensitive routes, and pin quantized model variant. Snippet to toggle cache in console:```
# enable prefix caching for account
PATCH /v1/accounts/2245/config
{ "prefix_cache": true }
```
Aisha (CSM): Action items: Jon — outreach + A/B ask; Miguel — one-pager on perf lifts from caching (due before call); Ellen — run invite + add CS playbook checklist; Aisha — prepare renewal-risk one-pager for AM.
Jon (AE): Got it. Outreach done within 48h. I'll push on timeline for competitor pilot.
Aisha (CSM): If they confirm competitor pilot scope during call, escalate to Exec sponsor for a QBR within 7 days. We want to be proactive.
Ellen (CS Ops): noted. Adding exec-sponsor flag to case. Case# CS-2245-PIGGYBACK
redwood-bot: [note] audit log: alert acknowledged by Aisha at 2025-11-13T14:02:11Z
Aisha (CSM): Thanks team — low-churn playbook on this one. Keep replies short in thread for handoff.
Jon (AE): 👍 will update after call.
